}}'''Efalin''' is a woman of the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]] and ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]''.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Efalin}}

== Appearance ==
She has short graying hair.

== Activities ==
She has stayed with the Shaido clan and fights in the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]].

She Travels to [[Ghealdan]] with [[Sevanna]] and all the other [[Wise Ones]]. She is one of the Shaido that capture [[Faile Bashere]], [[Morgase Trakand]] and [[Alliandre Maritha Kigarin]] and make them ''[[gai'shain]]''.
